机制概述: Kimbhe has a Staff Marker that gives Power to whoever stands on it. Her Styles and Unique Base let her control the Marker, leveraging it to enhance her attacks.

效果.效果: Setup: Place the Staff in the center of the board.

效果.条件: any fighter hits (after other Hit triggers)
效果.效果: <p-b>Whenever any fighter hits (after other Hit triggers),</p-b> if that fighter is on the Staff they gain <i-sb>+2 Power</i-sb>.
